failures.message:
These properties change how a deployment behaves and appear nowhere in docs/configuration-reference.md. An operator cannot set what is not written down, and a property nobody documents is one nobody reviews:
  eddi.workspaces.default-space (read in src/main/java/ai/labs/eddi/engine/security/spaces/WorkspaceSettings.java)
  eddi.workspaces.enabled (read in application.properties)
  eddi.workspaces.groups-claim (read in application.properties)
  eddi.workspaces.legacy-visibility (read in application.properties) ==> expected: <true> but was: <false>
